title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Ideal-gas conservative variables and viscous energy term exist, but numerical consistency is not demonstrated.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: tools/preprocess.py reads TRI/QUAD/BAR and multi-zone geometry; averaged centroids and boundary face count limit correctness.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Face residual exists, but Rusanov acoustic contribution is not scaled with edge length in main.cpp:40,55.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Rusanov is implemented but inconsistent scaling of acoustic dissipation undermines the flux.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Boundary types are implemented; slip reflection receives a non-unit normal main.cpp:52,55.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: Local least-squares linear face states exist; ghost-neighbor face states use cell averages.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Barth-type local bounds and positivity fallback present; no independent order evidence.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Stress/heat and tangential shear source exist, without validated completed laminar results.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Damped diagonal update exists, but line search and target use spatial residual and actual CFL cap differs from README.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF terms exist in update; inner stopping measures only spatial residual, and Re200 is absent.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: PyMETIS, owned/ghost mesh, neighbor state exchange and reductions exist; rank-ghost reconstructed states are absent.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
